title: Genome-wide DNA Replication Timing Analysis Using Click Chemistry-Based Biotinylation
author: Gökbuget, Lenshoek, et al.

steps.title: Prepare gelatin‑coated plates and seed cells
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml of 0.2 % gelatin solution to each well of a 6‑well plate, incubate 10 min at room temperature, aspirate gelatin, seed 2 × 10⁴ cells per well in 2 ml media, and incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ with daily media changes until at least 1 × 10⁶ cells are present (≈48 h, yielding ≥5 × 10⁵ cells for labeling).

steps.title: Stain DNA and sort S‑phase fractions
steps.instruction: Wash fixed cells once with 1 % BSA/PBS at RT (500 × g, 3 min), resuspend pellet in 500 µl PI/RNase staining solution, incubate 20 min in the dark at RT, keep on ice and sort 60 000 cells each into early and late S‑phase fractions using a linear PI channel (gates: G1‑2n to mid‑S, mid‑S to G2/M‑4n). Keep sorted cells on ice, extract genomic DNA with the NucleoSpin Tissue kit, elute in 100 µl H₂O, and store at –20 °C or proceed.

steps.title: Enrich biotinylated DNA with streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Heat 2× B&W buffer to 55 °C. Wash 49 µl streptavidin beads twice with 2× B&W buffer (magnet until clear, resuspend). Resuspend beads in 49 µl 2× B&W buffer (10 % excess). Adjust 25–50 ng size‑selected DNA to 49 µl with 0.1× TE, add the washed beads, mix by pipetting up/down 10×, incubate 15 min at RT. Wash 2 min with 200 µl heated 2× B&W, magnet 2–3 min; repeat wash/magnet once. Wash with 100 µl 0.1× TE, magnet 2–3 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend beads in 25 µl 0.1× TE.

steps.title: Perform end repair
steps.instruction: Combine 25 µl bead‑enriched DNA, 3.5 µl End Prep Reaction Buffer, and 1.5 µl End Prep Enzyme Mix; pipette up/down 10×. Incubate in a PCR machine: 120 °C for 30 min, 65 °C for 30 min, then hold at 34 °C.

steps.title: Ligate adapters
steps.instruction: Mix 30 µl end‑prepped DNA, 15 µl Ligation Master Mix, 0.5 µl Ligation Enhancer, and 1.25 µl Illumina adaptor (1:10). Dilute in Tris/NaCl (1 mM Tris pH 8, 10 mM NaCl). Pipette up/down 10×, incubate 120 °C for 15 min, then hold at 24 °C. Add 1.5 µl USER Enzyme, mix, and incubate 37 °C for 15 min (lid >45 °C).

steps.title: Wash beads and elute ligated DNA
steps.instruction: Place beads on magnet 2–3 min, discard supernatant, wash 2 min with 200 µl heated 2× B&W, magnet 2–3 min; repeat wash once. Wash with 100 µl 0.1× TE, magnet 2–3 min, discard supernatant, resuspend beads in 8 µl 0.1× TE. Elute by heating beads at 98 °C for 10 min (lid 105 °C), magnet 2–3 min, and transfer 7.5 µl supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: PCR amplify with unique i7 index
steps.instruction: Combine 7.5 µl eluted DNA, 12.5 µl NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix, 2.5 µl universal i7 primer, and 2.5 µl unique i7 primer. Pipette up/down 10×. Run PCR: 98 °C 30 s; 14 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 65 °C 20 s; final extension 65 °C 5 min; hold 4 °C. Adjust cycle number according to input to obtain >5 nM amplified DNA.

steps.title: SPRI bead purification
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 µl fresh 80 % EtOH per sample. Add 0.7 × volumes SPRI beads to the PCR reaction, mix, incubate 5 min at RT, magnet 2–3 min, discard supernatant, magnet again 2–3 min, wash twice with 200 µl 80 % EtOH (≈30 s each), dry beads 3–5 min (avoid over‑drying), elute with 21 µl 0.1× TE, incubate 2 min at RT, magnet 2–3 min, transfer 20 µl supernatant to a new tube. Store at –20 °C or continue.

steps.title: Assess library fragment size and concentration
steps.instruction: Run the final library on a Tapestation using D1000 reagents (or equivalent) to verify an average fragment size of 400–600 bp and a concentration >5 nM, which is required for Illumina sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Quality control: run `FastQC *.fastq` in the directory containing the raw reads.

Mapping: for each paired‑end set, run `bowtie2 -x '/path/to/bowtie2index' --no-mixed --no-discordant --reorder -X 1000 -1 mate1.fastq.gz -2 mate2.fastq.gz -S mapped.sam 2>> mapped.mapping.statistics.txt`. Convert and filter: `samtools view -bSq 20 mapped.sam > mapped.bam`; `samtools sort -o mapped.sorted.bam mapped.bam`; `samtools rmdup -S mapped.sorted.bam mapped.deduplicated.bam`.
Create 50 kb non‑overlapping bins: `bedtools makewindows -w 50000 -s 50000 -g mm10.genome.chrom.sizes > mm10.genome.50kb.bins.bed`.
Calculate read density per bin for each early and late BAM:
Merge RT files: `echo -e "chr\tstart\tstop\t$(ls *RT.bedGraph | tr ' ' '\t')" | sed 's/ /\t/g' > merge_RT.txt` then `bedtools unionbedg -filler "NA" -i *RT.bedGraph >> merge_RT.txt`.
